cues: Polar form is length and angle, with the angle taken from the plotted quadrant.
Multiplying multiplies lengths and adds angles.
De Moivre raises both to the n.
The n th roots sit on a regular polygon and add to zero.
One plus omega plus omega squared is zero.
And Euler's formula says e to the i theta is cos theta plus i sin theta.
